audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Level 3, First item and 2+ items to Akali, contradicting both the packet chart and the page's own whys[5] ('First item is yours') and whys[6] ('you win outright').
audit.why: packet.levelChart reads Tryndamere/Skill/Skill/Akali/Tryndamere/Tryndamere/Tryndamere and the matchup wins 52.11% over 2042 games.
audit.corrected: Level 3 to Skill, First item and 2+ items to Tryndamere; both layers proposed as pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twilight Shroud's 20/19/18/17/16s cooldown was never given, despite every trading rule being keyed to 'when Shroud is down'.
audit.why: The whole win condition is timing the Shroud window; without the number the advice cannot be executed.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and spikes[0].text now state the 20s rank-1 Shroud cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page twice claimed Five Point Strike heals her and called it mana-cheap. It does neither: Riot's text is damage plus a slow, and it costs 110/100/90/80/70 energy.
audit.why: Akali's only sustain in lane is a heal that Riot's Q description does not contain; selling her Q as a sustain tool tells the player to disengage from a trade he is winning.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text and mid rewritten: Q pokes and slows on a 1.5s cooldown for 110 energy at rank 1; Twilight Shroud makes her unselectable rather than merely 'a smoke screen'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Perfect Execution's execute component was never stated as a threshold.
audit.why: The R re-cast executes; the danger is an HP number, not a health bar, and Undying Rage is the answer only if spent before the re-cast lands.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d now ties the MR/Merc's purchase to the execute.
sources: enemyKit R text and execute flag

edits.before: Roughly even and skill-dependent: Akali's Q Five Point Strike pokes and heals, and her W Twilight Shroud gives her a smoke screen to reset trades. Punish her when W is down, but respect the mana-cheap Q poke that chips you between crits.
edits.after: Roughly even and skill-dependent: Five Point Strike pokes and slows on a 1.5s cooldown, and Twilight Shroud makes her unselectable so she can reset trades. Punish the 20s Shroud window, and watch her energy — that Q costs 110 at rank 1.

edits.before: Levels 2-5 are skill-dependent and roughly even. Akali's Q pokes and heals cheaply and her W smoke screen lets her dodge your commits and reset, so trades hinge on whether you catch her without Shroud; at level 6 her R burst threatens you before yours reliably answers.
edits.after: Levels 2-5 are skill-dependent and roughly even. Five Point Strike pokes and slows for 110 energy, and Twilight Shroud makes her unselectable for its whole duration, so trades hinge on catching her without Shroud; at 6 Perfect Execution threatens you before your R answers.

edits.before: Untargetable inside it. Crit when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Shroud is 20s at rank 1 and she is unselectable inside it — engage once it is down.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Perfect Execution's re-cast executes — get MR before you dip low.

notes: dontsFull[1].d and dontsFull[0].d were both generic filler unrelated to their own titles; only the one that could be replaced with a verified fact was rewritten. phases[5]/[6] ratings still read 4/10 while the side now reads Tryndamere — left alone rather than guessed, since the rating scale's meaning is not fixed by anything in the brief.
